brief:
Rapper Macklemore was removed as a supporting act from Ed Sheeran's US tour following pro-Palestinian comments he made on stage, Middle East Eye reported. The move sparked division among musicians, with Tommy Robinson backing Sheeran's decision while artists including Paloma Faith and Ms Rachel sided with Macklemore.

The incident reflects ongoing tensions within the entertainment industry over statements regarding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with prominent figures taking opposing stances on the removal.

title: Macklemore dropped from Sheeran tour after pro-Palestinian remarks
